'''House Lazari''' is a noble house in [[Arad Doman]].

The House was one of the founding Houses of Arad Doman, as Lord [[Jalaam Lazari]] co-founded the nation with Lord [[Ahran Nawaz]]  and Lady [[Bastine Almadar]] after taking [[Bandar Eban]] in c. {{fy|1096}}.<ref name="comp">[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Arad Doman.</ref> Lord Jalaam's second son, [[Shelaan Lazari]], was crowned the first King of Arad Doman in {{fy|1116}}. 

The House has not been mentioned in the late [[New Era]], and it is therefore known whether House Lazari still exists in the present day.
